sections.summary: Creator claims a 20% landing page conversion rate that generated $1.2M, shares his backstory of starting a wedding DJ business with $10K, and previews coverage of landing page elements, heat maps, and split tests.

Walks through setting up Anti-Gravity and Claude Code, building out a landing page using a claude.md file, then dissects landing page elements (headlines, video, case studies, B2B specifics, keyword/intent alignment), and demonstrates split testing and heat map tracking with PostHog and Vercel deployment.

Promotes his free Skool community for blueprints, his paid community offering training for starting an agency or scaling an existing business with seven coaching calls, and his agency offering a free 30-minute call.
